tagline: 理光旁轴相机，1959 年发布
description: 理光于1959年推出的旁轴相机。配备** Riken Optical Ricoh 4.5cm f/2.8 - 5 elements in 3 groups, made by Tomioka Optical (December 1959)。快门速度Seikosha SLV, Speeds 1/10 - 1/500 sec + B。manual focusing with help of coupled rangefinder。

specs.镜头: ** Riken Optical Ricoh 4.5cm f/2.8 - 5 elements in 3 groups, made by Tomioka Optical (December 1959)
specs.曝光测光: Light Value system with external light meter (The Light Value system was first adopted in Japan on the first Ricoh 500 version)
specs.对焦: manual focusing with help of coupled rangefinder
specs.重量: 720g for f2.8 version and 725 g for f1.9 version
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh Jet also named Ricoh 500 is a rangefinder camera with fixed lens made in Japan by Ricoh from 1959.
